description: This file provides client-side utility functions for filtering request lists based on location, issue description, and status within a mechanic portal application.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Normalizes free-text input by trimming, collapsing whitespace, converting to lowercase, removing diacritics, and punctuation for resilient 'contains' matching.

methods.name: containsNormalized
methods.description: Checks if the normalized haystack contains the normalized needle.

methods.name: extractLocationText
methods.description: Extracts location text from a request object, supporting nested JSON and multiple schema shapes.

methods.name: filterRequests
methods.description: Filters a list of request rows based on location, issue description, and status filters.

methods.name: countActiveFilters
methods.description: Counts the number of non-empty filters active.
